title: x-control-assessment
description: The outcome of a self-assessment, audit, or STAR questionnaire evaluating a specific control for a specific entity. Defined by the CSA Security Controls Catalog.
$comment: assessed_control_ref and entity_ref are required because they are constitutive: an assessment with no assessed control and no assessed entity is not an assessment. This follows the STIX sighting pattern, where sighting_of_ref is likewise required. See CONVENTIONS-STIX-MODELING.md, Constitutive references stay embedded.

entity_ref.description: The entity the assessment is about, as a standard STIX identity.

assessment_date.description: When the assessment was performed. Distinct from created/modified, which describe the object.

score.description: Range, scale, and meaning are undefined pending a working-group decision, so no bounds are asserted here. Distinct from the standard STIX confidence property.

newSdoExtension.description: Declares the object as a new SDO defined by a CSA extension-definition. The definition object must travel with the instance in any published bundle.
